features.label: Refused to be the messiah
features.detail: Dissolved the organization built around him and walked away from the role at thirty-four.

features.label: No method, on principle
features.detail: Rejects technique, system, and teacher, including himself. Frustrating entirely by design.

features.label: The private life contradicted it
features.detail: A long concealed affair. The gap between teaching and conduct is real and worth sitting with.
